name: Layers
description:
Layers MCP gives AI agents direct access to your Layers workspace, allowing them to configure, analyze, and optimize your Shopify search and merchandising experience without relying on fragile browser automation.

Agents can create and update search rules, merchandising campaigns, sort orders, collections, recommendations, ranking models, filters, redirects, synonyms, and other search configuration through a structured API. Changes happen in live collaborative edit sessions, so you can watch an agent work in real time, review proposed changes, test them, and publish only when you're ready.

Beyond configuration, Layers MCP provides access to search analytics and performance data so agents can identify opportunities, investigate issues, explain ranking decisions, and recommend improvements based on shopper behavior.

Common use cases include:

Audit and improve search relevance
Create merchandising campaigns for launches, promotions, and seasonal events
Optimize collection sorting and ranking strategies
Analyze zero-result and low-converting searches
Build recommendation experiences
Test configuration changes before publishing
Monitor search quality and suggest ongoing improvements
Automate repetitive merchandising workflows

Layers MCP is designed for both built-in AI assistants and bring-your-own-agent workflows, making it possible to integrate Claude, OpenAI, or custom agents directly into your merchandising operations.

Whether you're managing a single storefront or a large Shopify Plus catalog, Layers MCP enables AI agents to safely collaborate with your team while keeping every change reviewable, testable, and under your control.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Layers to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Layers to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.uselayers.com/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Layers MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Layers lists 15 MCP tools, including attributes-manage, browse, docs-search, merchandise-rules-manage, product-families, product-sequences, query_catalog, request-transforms-manage, search-autocomplete, search-semantic, store-details, and store-list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Layers?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Layers in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Layers requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Layers is developed by Layers. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
